summary: No public gene-level author result was located for either hypothalamus contrast: chronic DSS versus water control or intestinal Opa1 deletion versus floxed control. Every measurement column in the deposited matrix maps to a sample. The proposal passed the ledger-shape check, and all 89 retained source files passed SHA-256 verification. [Primary deposit](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress/studies/E-MTAB-15488)
openIssues: Author concordance remains untested for both contrasts. A gene-level author table or figure tied to either registered cohort would allow that comparison to be reopened.
